lines.trans: I'm telling you again, I didn't walk out! I fell out the window!
In one piece? Thank you, Arkashenka! Now I can go near the window.
The money! — What money? — Five thousand roubles!
Arkash, where would I get that kind of money? I'm a pensioner!

words.gram: masculine singular, vocative (short form of Arkasha)

lines.trans: I get twelve thousand! I can barely make ends meet.

lines.trans: Don't you yell at me! I told you in plain Russian.
I'm a pensioner! And I have no money!
So you cheated me? I'll get my revenge on you!
You already have! I keep telling you, my pension is twelve thousand.
Actually, Klavdia Viktorovna, he did his job.

words.gloss: actually, as a matter of fact

lines.trans: And you cheated him!
Look who's found a conscience! You stole a man from his family yourself!
And now she's lecturing an old grandmother about morals!
He and his wife have had a rocky relationship for a long time! — Yeah, tell me another one!

examples.trans: My grandmother lives in the village.

present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

вообще-то.gloss: actually, as a matter of fact

meanings.en: actually, strictly speaking, as a matter of fact
meanings.note: softens a correction or adds a second thought

examples.text: А вообще-то я ещё не решил.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Я не выходил! Я выпал из окна!
examples.trans: I didn't walk out! I fell out the window!
The first snow fell during the night.

meanings.en: to fulfil, to keep, to carry out
meanings.note: an order, promise, or part of a deal

examples.trans: I kept my part of the deal.

выходить.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.en: to go out, to come out

examples.trans: I'm going out in a minute.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.
That is better than twelve years.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
I can barely make ends meet.
I barely got up this morning.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: I'm with my wife this evening.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
the 'е' drops out in the other forms
ethical standards: учить морали = lecture about morals

examples.trans: And now she's lecturing an old grandmother about morals!

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
This man is waiting for you.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

найтись.gloss: to be found, to turn up

meanings.en: to be found, to turn up
meanings.note: when something lost is found again

examples.trans: Say thank you that the dog was found.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: to cheat, to deceive, to trick

examples.trans: If you cheat us, there'll be trouble.
He is looking out the window.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: Where does that word come from?

examples.text: А я испорчу отношения с будущим мэром.
examples.trans: And I'll ruin my relationship with the future mayor.

отомстить.gloss: to take revenge, to get back at

meanings.en: to take revenge, to avenge oneself

examples.trans: He wants to get back at his neighbour.
Grandma has been retired for a long time.

meanings.en: to come up to, to approach

получать.gloss: to receive, to get; to earn

meanings.note: almost always in 'всё равно' = it doesn't matter; мне всё равно = I don't care
ironic: Сталину расскажите = tell that to Stalin

examples.trans: I haven't got a single rouble.

meanings.note: also a Russian man (as a noun)
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

сводить.gloss: to bring together (концы с концами сводить = make ends meet)

examples.text: На такую зарплату трудно сводить концы с концами.
examples.trans: It is hard to make ends meet on such a salary.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word
спасибо за + accusative = thank you for
'а то' at the start of a sentence: 'а то мы уже начали беспокоиться' = we were starting to worry

examples.text: А то мы уже начали беспокоиться.
examples.trans: We were starting to worry, you see.
